candidates.description: This vector activates on three-digit numerical sequences that frequently appear as telephone area codes.
This feature vector represents sequential three-digit numbers in the 180s and 190s, occasionally contaminated by unrelated noise tokens.
This feature detects common Thai syllable endings, consonant clusters, and recurring sub-word tokens.
This vector represents Thai words, syllables, or subword tokens frequently containing the Thai consonant kho khwai (ค).
These tokens represent common Thai language characters, syllable fragments, and grammatical particles frequently appearing at the end of words or sub-word token boundaries.
This vector activates strongly for mixed-script text containing a combination of English words and Thai characters.
This vector represents sequential integers within a specific numeric range.
This feature vector activates strongly on two-digit numerical tokens representing integers or measurements.
This vector activates on a random assortment of multilingual text fragments, non-printing Thai vowel markers, and numerical tokens with no cohesive semantic theme.
This vector is related to numbers ending in zero, particularly increments of tens, hundreds, and thousands.
